title: Rotating Watch
description: SwiftCargo rotates refresh tokens on every use to limit the damage of a stolen cookie. Prove the rotation actually invalidates the old token: refresh once successfully, then try to reuse the original refresh token a second time.
successCondition: The first POST /api/auth/refresh call (with the original cookie) succeeds and returns a new session. A second call reusing the same original refresh token is rejected with 401 { error: { code: "UNAUTHORIZED" } }.
hints: The refresh token is delivered as an httpOnly cookie (th_refresh), not in the response body — you'll need to capture it at the HTTP layer, not by reading JSON.
Each successful refresh issues a brand-new refresh token and revokes the one that was presented; check the refresh_tokens table's revokedAt column if you want to verify at the DB layer too.
